name: start-a-timer-from-knoxx-notion-task

deploy.description: Knoxx Notion Tasks 'Track Time' button -> start (or restart) a Harvest timer for that task on the fixed Knoxx Foods - AI Ops Retainer project / Build task. One timer per task per day: the (task, day) -> time entry mapping lives in Zapier Table 01K5060J1B1FHCJEWVVH597B71 (Knoxx Notion Page ID column), so a second click the same day restarts the existing entry. Migrated from the classic Zap '(Knoxx) Start a Timer From Linear Description Emoji'.

trigger.trigger_note: Catch hook. The sender is the 'Track Time' button automation on the Tasks Database in the KNOXX Notion workspace. After the first publish, paste the `webhook_url` readback into that automation (it currently posts to the classic Zap's catch URL). `trigger_url` is Zapier-internal and answers an unauthenticated POST with 401 — never point Notion at it.

connections_note: Same Harvest connection and alias as start-a-timer-from-notion-task (numeric id 53227756, the classic Zap's authentication c600277…). Title: "Harvest dennis@work.flowers : Company Flow Pte. Ltd. (dba Work.Flowers". No Notion connection: the workflow reads only the button payload.

connectionless_apps.TableCLIAPI: find_record / create_record — Zapier Tables auth is automatic, no connection and no task cost

dependencies_note: zod is gone: the payload is extracted defensively by hand and nothing was being validated by the z.unknown() the sibling carries.

external_ids.harvest_user_note: Dennis Chiuten, from GET /v2/users/me on the bound connection — the value behind the classic Zap's Components.variables['019d489c-…'].
external_ids.harvest_project_note: "Knoxx Foods - AI Ops Retainer" (client Knoxx Business Group Pty Ltd), is_active true on 2026-09-30.
external_ids.harvest_task_note: "Build", active task assignment on that project on 2026-09-30.
external_ids.notion_actor_note: Dennis. Notion user ids are global; confirmed present in the Knoxx workspace's GET /v1/users (dennis@work.flowers) on 2026-09-30. Replaces the classic Zap's Components.variables['019d48a3-…'].
external_ids.knoxx_tasks_note: "Tasks Database" in the Knoxx Notion workspace. `Task ID` is its unique_id property. Only named here — the workflow never calls Knoxx Notion.

tables.01K5060J1B1FHCJEWVVH597B71: Linear Issue to Harvest Time Entry Mapping — f3 Time Entry ID, f4 Date (datetime), f5 Knoxx Notion Page ID. Shared with start-a-timer-from-notion-task, which writes f6 instead.
